stem: The differential system of voting where “persons better qualified or those supposed to have greater interest at stake are given more votes than those who are less qualified”, is called:

options.D: More than one of the above

note: Described system is plural (weighted) voting — not cumulative, contingent or 'excessive' → none of A/B/C.

stem: Which one of the following is the most important advantage of two-party system?

options.C: The governments in this system are more stable
options.D: More than one of the above

note: Two-party system yields more stable governments.

stem: The system of proportional representation is more likely to secure:

options.D: More than one of the above

note: PR secures minority representation.

options.D: More than one of the above
